import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_39/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_39/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_39/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_39/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# All source tables have the same schema ['x', 'y', 'label']
# UNION all source tables
df_union = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3], ignore_index=True)

# Convert 'x' and 'y' to integers by rounding (target examples show integer values)
df_union['x'] = df_union['x'].round().astype(int)
df_union['y'] = df_union['y'].round().astype(int)

# Ensure 'label' is string type
df_union['label'] = df_union['label'].astype(str)

# Reorder columns to match target schema ['label', 'x', 'y']
df_target = df_union[['label', 'x', 'y']]

# Write the result to the target path
df_target.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables
df_union = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY 'label' and sum 'x' and 'y'
df_grouped = df_union.groupby('label', as_index=False).agg({'x': 'sum', 'y': 'sum'})

# Convert 'x' and 'y' to integers as per target schema
df_grouped['x'] = df_grouped['x'].astype(int)
df_grouped['y'] = df_grouped['y'].astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema: ['label', 'x', 'y']
df_final = df_grouped[['label', 'x', 'y']]

# Write output CSV without index
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_39/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
